description:
Issue summary: Procurement request to purchase and onboard SignalWeave for Research and Product teams.
Impact: Faster runbook iteration, centralization of operational notes, reduced onboarding friction across incident responders and product engineers.
Request details: 90 permanent named seats for core team members + 30 ephemeral contractor seats (pooled tokens for short-term contractors), SCIM provisioning via Okta, SAML SSO, EU data residency, BYOK KMS option, and audit log export to Splunk.
Business need: Consolidate documentation and engineer-facing notes into a secure, auditable tool that supports code snippets and private notebooks; used for runbooks and post-incident artifacts.
Steps to complete:
  1) Procurement validates vendor quote and issues PO to SignalWeave.
  2) Legal reviews contract + DPA and negotiates SOC2 attestation references.
  3) Security reviews BYOK and export capabilities; sign-off on EU hosting.
  4) Identity team configures SCIM & SAML with Okta; test provisioning in staging.
  5) Finance completes invoicing setup and tags cost center RND-ENG-4001.
  6) Onboard initial pilot cohort (20 users) on 2026-04-15, then expand to remaining seats after 2-week pilot evaluation.
Notes: Vendor provided a 14-day pilot license for testing. Attachments include pricing quote and SOC2 factsheet.
